source_of_truth: Reading app/composables/useViewport.ts in a Nuxt app with SSR on: window.innerWidth is read only inside an onMounted callback (a client-only lifecycle that never runs on the server), and localStorage.getItem is read only inside an `if (import.meta.client)` guard. The setup top level touches no browser API. Server rendering therefore never evaluates window or localStorage, so there is no SSR crash and no hydration risk: the code already applies the prescribed fix (defer to the client / guard with import.meta.client). A naive 'window appears in a composable' reading would over-flag it; the correct verdict is clean.
provenance: blind generalization: truth derived from source without consulting tool output
